messages:
Nina Rao: Quick proposal  we run a 4-day GA mini-sprint to finalize scope, lock pricing bands, and validate runbooks. Need signoff on SLAs, monitoring alerts, docs, and support drills by end of week.

Samir Khan: sounds good. What's the minimal acceptance criteria we can ship with without escalating scope?

Nina Rao: Minimal acceptance: 1) Published SLA table (availability + per-size latency buckets) 2) Basic docs (Quickstart + migration notes + pricing FAQ) 3) Oncall runbook + billing escalation path 4) Canary ramp with automated rollback and 24h burn-in 5) Core dashboards and 3 synth checks. Anything else?

Priya Nair: Add: a customer-facing troubleshooting 1-pager and an L1 playbook for common billing questions. Support needs that to avoid escalations.

Nina Rao: agreed, Priya -> you're owner for L1 1-pager. Samir -> you own SLA table & canary test plan. I'll own docs consolidation + final approval. Billing Team -> provide final price bands and contact for escalations.

Samir Khan: for SLA numbers I propose: hosted availability 99.9% month, short-req 95th <300ms (<=256 tokens), medium 95th <700ms (257-2048), long best-effort <2s. Dedicated: uptime 99.95% and committed throughput targets. Thoughts?

Priya Nair: availability 99.9% is fine for hosted for GA. Also recommend we add an SLO for error rate: endpoint error-rate <0.2% rolling 1h.

Nina Rao: good catch. Include error-rate SLO.

DevOps Bot: canary schedule created: start=4929993600 stage1=1% 6h, stage2=5% 24h, stage3=20% 48h. Auto-rollback hooks enabled.

Samir Khan: monitoring needs: latency histograms (p50/p90/p95/p99), request size distribution, queue depth, mem/GPU pressure, KV cache hit rate, per-model error-rate. Alerts: page on >50% deviation on p95 vs baseline or error-rate >0.3% absolute for 10m.

Support Ops: we'll author L1 1-pager + full runbook. Need the billing contact and preferred escalation emails. Billing Team, can you confirm?

Billing Team: assigning Ben Li (finance) for escalation; provide official pricing bands by Thu morning. we'll also prepare example invoice lines and an overage protection paragraph.

Nina Rao: timeline & owners: Thu AM - Billing bands (Billing Team), Thu EOD - SLA table & canary test plan (Samir), Fri AM - L1 1-pager draft (Support Ops), Fri EOD - Docs consolidation + final signoff (Nina). We'll lock scope if no blocker by Fri EOD and start canary next Tue.

Samir Khan: test plan notes: include steady-state soak of at least 48h at stage3 traffic, and a short adversarial test (burst 2x expected qps) to validate throttling and graceful degradation. I'll add exact scripts to the repo.

Priya Nair: Support drill: run a 30-min mock escalation on Friday with oncall and billing rep to validate the flow. Recommend we record it.

Nina Rao: excellent. mark action items and react with :white_check_mark: when you accept. Will post a synthesized checklist to #product after this thread.

Samir Khan: :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: :white_check_mark:

Support Ops: :white_check_mark: starting runbook now

Billing Team: :white_check_mark: Ben will ping with numbers Thu AM

Nina Rao: thanks everyone  trying to keep this tight. If any blocker emerges, call it out here asap.
